The initial wheel and laser poses are paired once. Their SE(2) alignment stays fixed for this session; later drift is not continually corrected to match the wheels.

The EKF may continue predicting when an input stops. A fresh filtered message alone does not establish healthy sensor fusion.

This page observes odometry and has no movement controls. Keep your existing teleop stack in its own terminal. Clear visible trails changes this browser only; it does not reset robot odometry, the filter or CSV history. Source separation is not ground-truth position error. Measuring accuracy requires the operator's repeatable physical trials.
